instruction: What is a Binary Search Tree (BST)?
response: A Binary Search Tree is a tree structure where every node follows a simple rule: smaller values go to the left, and larger values go to the right. This makes searching, inserting, and deleting very quick when the tree is balanced.

instruction: What is a Key-Value (KV) Cache in LLM inference?
response: A KV Cache saves the computed Key and Value tensors from past words so the model doesn't recompute them for every single new word generated. It speeds up generation from quadratic O(T^2) down to linear O(T) per token!
